payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the architectural simplifications made to achieve the same performance in the SEPT model.

claims.text: The architecture was simplified by removing the pruner and using under-sampling to balance samples, which reduced the search space.
The original network architecture was simplified by extracting span representation through a simple pooling layer instead of using additional attention or LSTM networks.
Despite these simplifications, the SEPT model achieved the same performance as more complex models.
